# BuildDeploy Tech

BuildDeploy Tech is a software company based in Noida, Delhi NCR (Uttar Pradesh, India) that builds its own SaaS products, delivers custom software and SaaS solutions, and provides web, mobile, cloud, and SEO services for businesses.

BuildDeploy Tech provides:
- Software Products (own SaaS — BDT Retail billing & retail platform)
- Custom Software & SaaS Solutions
- Web Development
- Mobile App Development
- WordPress Development
- SEO Services
- DevOps & Cloud Solutions
- Government Tender Services
